# Textures

- `earth.jpg`: the world picture, 1024 x 512, equirectangular (longitude -180 to 180 across, latitude 90 to -90 down). A smaller copy of the `earth_atmos_2048.jpg` image from the three.js examples.
- `moon.jpg`: the Moon, 512 x 256. A smaller copy of `moon_1024.jpg` from the three.js examples.

Both come from the user's own Panchangam Sky project, which got them from the three.js examples (NASA imagery). Check the source licence before you ship a new release.
`rupaka.render.textures_js` puts them in the three.js bundle as data URIs.
